name: wf-node-ts
description: wf Node/TypeScript stack pack — the node-ts capability owning a dependency-free unit-test harness for pure TS helpers (parsers, formatters, coercion helpers) that need no Angular runtime. Ships the test runner itself as a declared payload, installed only when the capability is selected. Composed with wf core via the capability registry; the implement phase aggregates its test-authoring guidance when registered. Tracker-agnostic (requires: git only). Ships /wf-node-ts:init for one-command self-registration.
